data.body: Change 3538 PS1 (4e4023a3e46): local make verify green (21918 + 231 passed); LLM-Review +1 with 2 advisories. Fixing advisory 1 in place before landing: my doc text said rebar store doctor does not find entries saved the old way; doctor's _scan_client does read top-level mcpServers of ~/.copilot/mcp-config.json and ~/.claude.json when the cwd has no project .mcp.json, so Copilot and Claude user-scope entries ARE reported as pat-literal-in-config. Reworded; only Claude local-scope entries (per-project in ~/.claude.json) are invisible. Advisory 2 (no test pins the Copilot example's braced form) is left as is: the guard now parses every example JSON.
